1.fitzpatrick_label: Type I — very sun-sensitive; usually burns, little tanning
1.skin_response_note: Fitzpatrick type changes risk/response interpretation, not environmental TanScore. Published MED/MMD values overlap substantially within types; objective skin color or measured MED/MMD is more precise.

2.fitzpatrick_label: Type II — sun-sensitive; burns readily, tans minimally
